Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Greets!
>
> Can one play prevent cards cost blood at 0 if just stole 2 blood with theft of vitae?
>
I'm not sure I understand what you meant, so here are a couple of scenarii.

A and B are in combat. A has 0 blood, B has 2 blood.

* A's strike is superior Theft of Vitae. B's strike is a handstrike.
We resolve Theft of Vitae before dealing with the damage, so A can play Rolling with the Punches (costs 1 blood) or Skin of Rock (costs 0 blood).
B cannot play prevention cards, since there B has no damage to prevent.

* A plays Carrion Crows and strikes with Theft of Vitae. B's strike is a handstrike.
We first resolve Theft of Vitae (A now has 2 blood, B has no blood). B can play Skin of Rock (costs 0 blood), but not Armor of Vitality (costs 1 blood) to prevent the damage from Carrion Crows.
